# Empire Barber Expo

> An expo for barbers and hairstylists in Calgary, Alberta, run by Empire Barber Supply. Part 3, "The Fusion of Barbering & Hairstyling", is on Sunday, May 2, 2027 at the Big Four Roadhouse, Stampede Park, 1801 Big Four Trail SE, Calgary. Tickets go on sale November 9, 2026.

## The 2027 expo
- Name: Empire Barber Expo 2027, Part 3: The Fusion of Barbering & Hairstyling
- Date: Sunday, May 2, 2027
- Venue: Big Four Roadhouse, Stampede Park, 1801 Big Four Trail SE, Calgary, AB
- Who it's for: barbers, hairstylists and the brands that supply them
- What happens: stage education, a trade show floor, competitions and awards
- Tickets: on sale November 9, 2026. Join the waitlist at https://barberexpo.ca/ to get the ticket link by email.
- Free passes: the first 10 people to click the link in the ticket-drop email get a free pass.

## Past expos
- 2025: Sunday, April 13, 2025, Big Four Roadhouse, Calgary
- 2026 (Part 2): Sunday, April 12, 2026, Big Four Roadhouse, Calgary. 45 vendors on the floor.

## Vendors
- Booths are 10 ft x 10 ft. Each includes an 8 ft black backwall drape, 3 ft black sidewall drape, a 6 ft black skirted table, 2 folding chairs, a wastebasket and 3 expo access passes.
- Electrical is sold separately through the Global Convention Services vendor portal.
- Merchandise shipped to the organizers is delivered to the venue free of charge.
- Vendor set-up is Saturday, May 1, 2027.
- Request a booth: https://barberexpo.ca/vendors/
